overview_description.description:
Lotus is the open-source pricing, packaging, and billing engine for SaaS companies. We provide realtime infrastructure that enables flexible pricing and packaging experimentation while integrating into existing quote-to-cash solutions.

https://github.com/uselotus/lotus
